recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Spaghetti
recipes.description: Bright, glossy weeknight pasta with lemon, garlic and parmesan.

ingredients.name: spaghetti
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Any long pasta works; gluten-free pasta is a possible swap (cooking time varies).

ingredients.name: parmesan, finely grated
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Nutritional yeast is a common dairy-free suggestion. Check labels if cooking for allergies.

steps.instructionText: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a rolling boil.
Add the spaghetti and stir. Cook until just al dente, about 9 minutes.
Meanwhile, warm the olive oil, garlic and chili flakes in a wide pan over low heat. Don't let the garlic brown.
Zest and juice the lemon. Grate the parmesan.
Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Toss the pasta in the garlic oil with the lemon, parmesan and a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Season with salt, scatter over the parsley and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
recipes.description: Creamy one-pot curry with spinach. Freezes well.

ingredients.name: curry powder
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Garam masala plus a pinch of turmeric is a possible swap. Some blends contain allergens; check the label.

steps.instructionText: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until soft and golden.
Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Add the curry powder and stir constantly for 30 seconds to toast the spices.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer, stirring now and then.
Add the coconut milk and chickpeas. Simmer gently until thickened.
Stir in the spinach until just wilted.
Squeeze in the lime, season with salt and serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.title: Masala Omelette
recipes.description: A spiced, herby breakfast omelette in ten minutes.

ingredients.name: butter or ghee
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Oil is a possible dairy-free swap.

steps.instructionText: Whisk the eggs with the turmeric and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the onion, tomato, chili and cilantro.
Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat. Pour in the eggs and cook until the edges set.
Flip or fold the omelette and cook for one more minute.
Slide onto a plate and eat while hot.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Paprika Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy chicken thighs roasted with potatoes and peppers on one tray.

steps.instructionText: Heat the oven to 220 °C / 425 °F.
Halve the potatoes, chunk the peppers and cut the onion into wedges.
On a large tray, toss everything with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Chicken skin-side up.
Roast until the skin is crisp and the potatoes are tender.
Check the chicken is cooked through: 75 °C / 165 °F at the thickest part.
Rest for five minutes, then serve with the lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Fluffy Banana Pancakes
recipes.description: Weekend pancakes that use up spotty bananas.

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Oat or soy milk are common swaps. Check labels if cooking for allergies.

steps.instructionText: Mash the bananas in a bowl until mostly smooth.
Whisk in the eggs and milk.
Fold in the flour and baking powder until just combined. Lumps are fine. Let it rest.
Melt a little butter in a pan over medium heat. Add small ladles of batter.
Cook until bubbles appear on top, then flip.
Cook the second side until golden. Repeat with the rest of the batter.

recipes.title: Roasted Tomato & Basil Soup
recipes.description: Velvety pantry soup. Great with a grilled cheese.

ingredients.name: vegetable stock
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Some stock cubes contain gluten or celery; check the label.

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Coconut milk is a possible dairy-free swap.

steps.instructionText: Warm the oil in a large pot. Cook the onion gently until soft.
Add the garlic and cook for one minute.
Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar. Simmer, crushing the tomatoes with a spoon.
Take off the heat, add most of the basil and blend until smooth. Be careful with hot liquid.
Stir in the cream, season, and serve topped with the remaining basil.

recipes.title: Veggie Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Fast, smoky fried rice. Best with day-old rice.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Tamari is a common gluten-free suggestion. Check the label.

steps.instructionText: Heat half the oil in a wok or large pan over high heat. Scramble the eggs, then set aside.
Add the rest of the oil, the garlic and the peas and carrots. Stir-fry until hot.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps. Fry without stirring too often so it crisps.
Return the eggs, add the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions. Toss and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mug Cake
recipes.description: A warm single-serve cake from the microwave.

ingredients.name: chocolate chips
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Chopped dark chocolate works too. Chocolate may contain milk or nuts; check the label.

steps.instructionText: In a large mug, mix the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder and salt.
Stir in the milk and oil until smooth. Drop the chocolate chips on top.
Microwave on high until risen and just set in the middle.
Let it cool for a couple of minutes. The mug will be hot.

recipes.title: Dal Tadka
recipes.description: Comforting yellow lentils finished with sizzling cumin and garlic.

ingredients.name: toor dal (split pigeon peas)
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Red lentils (masoor dal) are a common swap and cook faster.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Ghee is traditional but not vegan.

steps.instructionText: Rinse the dal in a sieve until the water runs clear.
Put the dal, water and turmeric in a pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer until soft, stirring now and then.
Mash the dal lightly with the back of a spoon and season with salt.
For the tadka, heat the oil in a small pan. Add the cumin; when it crackles, add the garlic and chilies.
Add the onion and cook until golden, then the tomato until soft.
Pour the tadka over the dal, stir, scatter the cilantro and serve with rice or roti.

recipes.title: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.description: Soft paneer in a rich, mildly spiced tomato and butter sauce.

ingredients.name: paneer, cubed
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Firm tofu is a possible dairy-free swap.

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Coconut cream is a possible dairy-free swap.

steps.instructionText: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion until soft.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for one minute.
Stir in the tomato puree, chili powder and sugar. Simmer until thick and glossy.
For a silky restaurant-style sauce, blend it smooth. You can skip this step.
Add the cream, garam masala, crushed fenugreek leaves and paneer. Simmer gently.
Season with salt and serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Upma
recipes.description: Savory South Indian semolina breakfast with crunchy lentils and vegetables.

ingredients.name: semolina (rava)
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Contains gluten. Millet rava is a possible gluten-free swap.

steps.instructionText: Dry-roast the semolina in a pan, stirring, until it smells toasty. Set it aside.
Heat the oil. Add the mustard seeds; when they pop, add the urad dal, curry leaves, chili and ginger.
Add the onion and vegetables and cook until soft.
Pour in the water, add the salt and bring to a boil.
Lower the heat. Pour in the semolina slowly, stirring all the time so no lumps form.
Cover and cook on low heat until fluffy.
Squeeze over the lemon, scatter the cilantro and serve hot.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pulao
recipes.description: Fragrant one-pot basmati rice with whole spices and vegetables.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Ghee is traditional but not vegan.

steps.instructionText: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then soak it.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot. Add the cumin, bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves and cardamom and let them sizzle.
Add the onion and cook until golden.
Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and vegetables and cook for two minutes.
Drain the rice and add it with the water and salt. Bring to a boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat.
Turn off the heat and rest, covered, then fluff with a fork and serve.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi
recipes.description: A cool, creamy mango and yogurt drink.

ingredients.name: plain yogurt
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Coconut yogurt is a possible dairy-free swap.

steps.instructionText: Peel the mango and chop the flesh.
Put the mango, yogurt, milk, sugar and cardamom in a blender and blend until smooth.
Taste and add more sugar if you like. Pour over ice and serve.

recipes.title: Classic Guacamole
recipes.description: Chunky, zesty avocado dip in ten minutes. No cooking.

ingredients.name: tortilla chips, to serve
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Some brands contain gluten; check the label.

steps.instructionText: Halve the avocados, remove the stones and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Add the lime juice and mash with a fork. Keep it a little chunky.
Fold in the onion, tomato, cilantro, jalapeño and salt.
Taste, adjust the lime and salt, and serve straight away with the chips.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Crisp vegetables, olives and feta with an oregano dressing.

ingredients.name: feta cheese
ingredients.substitutionNotes: A plant-based feta is a possible dairy-free swap.

steps.instructionText: Cut the tomatoes into wedges and slice the cucumber into half-moons.
Thinly slice the red onion and green pepper.
Put the vegetables and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over, lay the feta on top, sprinkle with oregano and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
recipes.description: Juicy shrimp in garlicky lemon butter, ready in 15 minutes.

ingredients.name: large shrimp, peeled and deveined
ingredients.substitutionNotes: Shellfish is a major allergen. Chicken pieces or firm tofu are possible swaps (cook times change).

steps.instructionText: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
Melt one tablespoon of butter in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp in one layer and sear.
Flip the shrimp and cook until pink all the way through.
Lower the heat. Add the rest of the butter, the garlic and chili flakes, and stir for one minute.
Squeeze over the lemon, add the parsley, toss and serve.
Peel the bananas and mush them together.
Whip the two eggs and mix them with the sugar.
Melt the butter, cut the chocolate into smaller pieces, and whip the eggs.
Pour the butter into the bananas, then add the flour, then the cooking powder, the chocolate, the whipped eggs and sugar, and the optional vanilla sugar; stirring it all the time.
Pour the mass into your muffin dish.
Heat up the oven to 160 °C / 320 °F and bake the muffins for around 20-30 minutes at 170 °C / 340 °F.

ingredients.name: pcks vanilla sugar or other vanilla flavouring

steps.instructionText: Beat the eggs till creamy.
Gradually add all the sugar and the vanilla flavouring.
Melt and then mix in the butter.
Add the baking powder.
Add the milk and flower in alternation. Stir constantly while doing so.
Blend and mix until you got a smooth dough. Use the highest speed of your mixer.
Let the dough rest for a couple of minutes. Turn on & preheat your waffle maker, then pour in the dough. Bake inside the waffle maker till golden brown.

ingredients.name: (Optional) More mozzarella and parmesan for fans of cheese.

steps.instructionText: Preheat oven to 400F/200C.
Dice chicken and pan cook with oil until fully cooked.
Cook the pasta for a few minutes less than usual (about 7-8 minutes).

Add chicken and pasta into a casserole dish. Mix together. Add diced tomato and shredded mozzarella cheese and keep mixing. Top with parmesan cheese and bread crumbs for an even coat. Add about a spoonful of butter evenly on the top.
Cook in the oven for 22-25 minutes, until the top looks golden.

ingredients.name: 50-70% dark chocolate chips or semi-sweet milk chocolate chips

steps.instructionText: Preheat oven to 375°F
Mix the flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl
Using a mixer or whisk, beat the butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla and milk in a separate bowl for a few mins
Combine and stir in the dry ingredients, then the chocolate chips

Use an ice cream scooper or spoon to make uniform balls of cookie dough to the size you like and evenly space them out on a parchment paper lined baking sheet (you may need more than one sheet depending on the size of the cookies)
Bake in the oven one baking sheet at a time for around 8-10 minutes, taking them out when they start to brown
Cool for a few minutes then put them on a cooling rack
Melt the sugar with the coffee in a Bain Marie
Break the eggs separate yolks from whites in different containers.
Melt butter in sugar coffee Bain Marie.
Whisk whites 'till they froth.
Pour cocoa into Bain Marie and mix well.
Preheat the oven (180 °C).
Pour the yolks into the Bain Marie, mix well.
Pour the mixture in the Bain Marie into the bowl with the whites.
Sieve the flour and baking powder into the bowl with the whites.
Mix everything in the bowl in a folding manner.
Butter the baking pan and pour in the mixture.
Leave in oven for 45 min. If after 45 min the cake hasn't come away from the sides
In a large bowl, mix all dough ingredients except butter.

Kneed in the butter gradually until dough passes the "Windowpane Test": Take a piece of the dough and stretch it gently apart, it should spread out smoothly until light is visible through the dough without tearing. This is a sign of good gluten development.
Let rise for 90 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix all filling ingredients.
Take risen dough and roll it into a rectangle the size of your pan.
Spread your filling inside your dough.
Roll the dough into a log and cut into rolls.
Place inside your pan and let rise for 30 minutes.
Wash melted butter over your rolls and bake at 175°C.
Drizzle frosting as soon as rolls come out of the oven, let cool, tear and serve.

ingredients.name: or less of Xanthan Gum (optional, to have a more stick bread)

steps.instructionText: Mix all dry ingredients in a big bowl.
Add the whole eggs and the coconut oil.
Mix well with a spoon until it gets thick. You can add extra coconut flour if you feel it is too liquid.
Pre-heat your oven to 350°F.
Pour the dough evenly into a Bread/Loaf form (coated with butter or parchment paper) and cook for 35 to 45 min.
After cooking, remove it from the oven and let it sit while it cools down.
Some variations can be done, like using butter instead of coconut oil or adding pumpkin pure to the mix and having a cake-like texture.

ingredients.name: a little bit of salt (1/3 of a teaspoon)

steps.instructionText: Put all the ingredients in a bowl and stir until it's all mixed up.
Preheat a pan with butter or margarine.
Turn when one side starts turning brown.
They are done when both sides start turning brown.
Add Butter or Margarine when needed.

recipes.title: Fennel White Bean and Kale Soup

ingredients.name: kale, (escarole, swiss chard, or spinach can also be used).
grated parmesan, plus extra for serving if desired

steps.instructionText: In a large soup pot, heat olive oil over medium.
Add fennel, onion, rosemary and mix until tender (4-6 min).
Add garlic, red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant (1 min).
Add one handful of greens at a time, stirring until leaves wilt.
Add white beans, broth, and black pepper,
Bring to boil then bring to simmer while mashing some of the beans with a wooden spoon. Simmer until liquid has reduced and simmered (6-8 mins)
Take off heat, stir in lemon juice and parmesan. Serve with some toasted bread that is good at scooping up soup. Enjoy!
Cut the avocados in half, open them and place the pulp in a bowl.
Mash the avocados, add lime juice, mix and mash some more.
Mince the cilantro, tomato and onion and add them to the avocado mix.
Add salt and black pepper to taste and mix thoroughly.
Enjoy fresh with some totopos!
Cut pork belly into 1 inch cubes.

In a small frying pan place pork cubes fattiest side down in dry pan, put gas on lowest level possible flame, cover with lid. Ideally your pork covers the entire surface of the small pan---crowding is good for this recipe.

Lard will render out of the pork allowing it to confit cook in its own juice. Low flame essential. Turn the pork 3 or 4 times until all sides are golden and fat is rendered to melt in mouth levels. This will take around 1hr.
Remove pork belly and place in a bowl and cover. Remove around half the liquified lard and store for other uses.

Add diced ginger, smashed garlic cloves and chopped chili and sauté in the remaining lard. Once these are softened add the ketchup, hoisin sauce and honey. Reduce over very low heat for a few minutes until thickened.
Add the pork belly to the sauce and cook on low for a further 2 minutes. Leave to stand for 5 minutes then add thinly sliced spring onions to garnish. Enjoy with steamed white rice.
Preheat oven to 350°F
Season the chicken. Rub the thighs with some olive oil and season liberally with salt and pepper.
Place the chicken thighs in a cold skillet, skin-side down. Cook for 15 minutes on medium-low heat without touching them.
Prepare Sriracha sauce by stirring honey and sriracha together in a bowl.
Flip the chicken thighs. Cook for another 10 minutes.
Place chicken thighs on baking tray (or just use skillet if using a cast-iron skillet). Drizzle the sriracha sauce on both sides of the chicken, coating it. You do not have to use all of it.
Bake chicken thighs for 15 minutes.
Test chicken for doneness. Chicken should reach internal temperature of 165°F.

If chicken is near done (or done), you can baste a second time with the remaining sauce (you can make more sauce if you need) and return to oven for 5 more minutes. Do not worry about overcooking; chicken thighs are difficult to overcook.
When chicken is done, let cool for a few minutes and garnish with sesame seeds before serving.
Cut the sausage into sticks and dice the onion.
Fry the sausage and onion in oil for about ten minutes. Add the tomato purée and cook for another minute.
Stir in cream, milk, soy sauce and Dijon mustard. Let it simmer for at least five minutes.
Season to taste with plenty of pepper, and possibly salt.
Serve with boiled rice. Optionally top with freshly ground pepper and/or garnish with chopped parsley.
Set oven to preheat 400 degrees F.
While oven is heating up, mix dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl: flour, sugar, and salt.
Add milk and eggs to dry ingredients and mix with a hand mixer.

Once the oven has reached 400F, add one stick of butter into a 9x13 inch glass baking pan, then place it in the oven for a few minutes until the butter has completely melted. Avoid burning the butter by leaving it in the oven too long.
Using heavy oven mitts, remove pan from oven and pour batter into hot pan containing melted butter.
Bake for 40 minutes or until the pancake puffs up and is nicely browned.
Remove from oven and sprinkle additional small amount of nutmeg over the top of of your kropsua.
To serve, cut the pancake into squares. Top with maple syrup and serve immediately.
Cover the baking tin with some butter.
Heat the oven for 200°C.
Mix all of the ingredients.
Fill dough in the baking tins pits.
Bake for 7 min. in the oven at 200°C.
Serve hot with berries and vanilla ice-creame.

ingredients.name: dry brown lentils, soaked overnight and drained

steps.instructionText: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot, and bell pepper; cook and stir until vegetables begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, tomatoes, chorizo and bay leaf; cook about 4 minutes.
Add lentils and water (water should be about an inch deeper than the level of the lentils).
Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low; simmer, uncovered, until lentils are just cooked, 15 to 20 minutes.

ingredients.name: 15oz cans of kidney beans (or 6 cups cooked beans)
29oz large can tomato sauce (or 4 cups fresh tomato sauce)
15oz can diced tomatoes (or 1 large diced tomato with skin removed)

steps.instructionText: Chop the large onion and mince the garlic cloves.
On medium-low heat in a large tall pot add 2-3 tbsp olive oil.
Add the chopped onions into the pot with oil and constantly stir for 5-10 minutes until they begin to brown.
Just before onions are done add the minced garlic to the pot and let cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, sweet corn, beans, and rice.
Turn up the heat to medium.
Add each of the spices, taste the chili, and adjust flavoring accordingly.
Let cook for 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Thoroughly rinse the lentils and drain the water.
Put the lentils in the pot, and add 1 L (0.26 gal) of water.
Bring to a boil, and gently boil for about 15-20 minutes.
Drain the water.
Add the other ingredients to the pot.
Add 1½-2 tsp of salt and a little bit of ground black pepper.
Add 0.5 L (0.13 gal) of boiling water.
Simmer for about 10 minutes.

ingredients.name: chopped scallions white and green separated)
inch minced ginger (similar amount as garlic)
soft tofu cut into 1.5cm (1/2 inch cubes)

steps.instructionText: Marinade the pork in shaoxing cooking wine, a splash of cooking oil, the soy sauce,
Add cooking oil to a wok and sear the ground pork until browned, chopping it up as it cooks
Add the doubanjiang and let it simmer for about a minute
Add the minced aromatics (ginger, garlic) scallion whites, and dou-chi and cook until fragrant
Add the stock and a splash of soy sauce, turn up the gas and bring to a boil
Add the tofu, lower the gas, and braise for around 15 mins
You'll know it's done when the tofu shows their trademark "pockmarks" and the seasoning sticks to them
Mix in the crushed Sichuan peppercorns and green parts of the scallions right before serving
Serve over steamed rice
Boil some water and put the tomatoes in it and leave them for a couple of minutes
Chop the onions and peppers into small pieces
Take the tomatoes out of the water and peel them off
Chop the tomatoes into 4 or 6 pieces
Put the butter on the pan and wait till it's melted
Put onions and peppers on the pan
You can add some salt (it will make them a little crispy) and stir till the onions are starting to get brown
Add tomatoes and start mashing them with a spoon
When the tomatoes are all mushed-up, add the eggs and seasonings
Stir some more untill everything is mixed up well
Cover up the pan so eggs don't stay raw on the top
It should be ready in 2 or 3 minutes.

ingredients.name: instant yeast or 1.25/4 tsp active dry yeast

steps.instructionText: Mix the dry ingredients then add the hot water. It should come out as a firm dough.
Leave the dough at room temperature for 12 hours. You can then keep the dough in the fridge for up to 48 hours before cooking.
Preheat oven and pan to 450 F (230 C).
Bake for 30 minutes covered (e.g. aluminum foil), then 20 minutes uncovered.

ingredients.name: milk (4 tbsp) (you can use water instead)
baking powder (or baking soda + some acid to activate it)

steps.instructionText: Mix eggs, sugar, honey and milk.
In another bowl mix oat flour and baking powder.
Combine two mixtures and let the batter rest for about 15 minutes.
Preheat the pan for 5 minutes over low (~33%) heat, cook for about 1 - 1.5 minutes then flip when you see bubbles come out and cook for another 45s - 1 minute.
Eat them with raspberry (or any other) jam.
Pour milk into blender
Slice bananas into a few pieces each and add to blender, blend until combined.
Scoop yogurt into blender and blend until combined.
Scoop peanut butter into blender and blend until combined.
If using eggs, scramble and cook them on the stove. Add them to blender and blend until combined.
Divide blender contents between 3 storage containers, such as tupperware.
Divide oats into each contatiner.
Mix each container throughoughly so that the oats are well distributed and are not clumped together.
Let soak in refridgerator for at least 12 hours.
Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Let the dough rest for ~15 mins.
Heat a pan with a bit butter or oil.
For each pancake spread a ladle of dough in the pan and bake them at lower medium temperature until they are brown on both sides.

ingredients.name: pasta. Usually I prefer to use fusilli or penne, but any short-cut pasta

steps.instructionText: Add olive oil to your frying pan, heat it to medium-high heat.
Chop some onions and add them to the preheated pan.
After a couple of minutes add the ground beef to the pan, salt it and mix it
When the meat is almost done, mince the garlic and add it together with the
Cook the pasta in a pot until its done al dente while the beef is being
Grate the tomatoes over the pan using a grater with small-sized slots, in
Grate the carrot using a grater with medium-sized slots and add it to the
Salt some more to taste, and add some black pepper to taste, mix.
Cook it over medium/medium-low heat for about 10-15 minutes or until the
Once (or if) the pasta and beef is already cooked, add the pasta to the pan
Serve hot and enjoy!

ingredients.name: (optional) Whipped cream, fresh fruit such as kiwifruit, passionfruit, and strawberries

steps.instructionText: Beat all ingredients until smooth, stiff and shines.
Continue beating mixture until soft peak forms when lifting beater (approx 12 minutes).
Place on baking paper on tray.
Bake in middle of oven at 180˚C (350-360˚F) for 10 minutes.
Drop temperature down to 150˚C (300˚F) for 45 minutes.
Turn off oven and leave to cool in oven.
(Optional) Serve with fruit salad and ice cream.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic. Sauté about 5 minutes, until soft.
Stir in curry powder and cook about 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add all other ingredients. Stir well.
Bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve over rice.
Peel the potatoes and cut them to small pieces.
Put them in a pot and cover with water.
Bring to boil and cook until potatoes are soft.
Drain and mash with a fork.
Warm up milk, but don't let it boil.
Still on the fire, add butter and mashed potatoes, and optionally grated cheese, and stir until uniform.
Keep stirring on the fire to thicken as you like.

ingredients.name: quark (plain yoghurt can be used as a replacement)
(Optional) Alcohol by eye so that they do not soak up so much oil

steps.instructionText: Mix ingredients (quark, eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder) in one bowl.
Pour the sunflower oil into a cooking pot and heat up the hotplate
Form balls from the dough and put them into the cooking pot
Once they are brown-ish, put them onto a plate
(Optional) add icing sugar
Enjoy!
Prepare 3 bowls. (One with flour, one with beaten eggs, one with bread crumbs seasoned with salt and paprika)
Wash the veal and gently dry it with kitchen roll.
Put the veal on a board and beat it with a meat tenderizer (or a rolling pin) to a thickness of 0.5 cm. (Beating the veal makes it tender)
Season the veal with salt and pepper on both sides, dive it through the 3 bowls. (First flour, then eggs, finally bread crumbs)
Melt the butter in a deep pan. (Attention: not too hot. Butter should not turn brown)
Fry the veal on each side until it is gold brown. (e.g. 3 min on each side)
Serve with a piece of lemon.

ingredients.name: Celery, diced (try to get one with lots of green leaves)
Heinz chili sauce (it looks like ketchup but is not)
x 14.5oz cans of diced tomato - optionally blend one

steps.instructionText: Sauté raw vegetables in oil
add remaining ingredients except shrimp
simmer 1 hour
Add shrimp and cook for 5 minutes
Serve over cooked rice
[optional] Best if cooked a day ahead and reheated.
Put 750mL of water and the peels of five onions in a pot and let them cook for five minutes. Remove the peels about twenty minutes later.
Put the eggs, one teaspoon of sugar, two tablespoons of salt and all spices (but vinegar and garlic) in the pot, bring it to a boil and cook them for seven minutes.
Use a spoon to remove the eggs from the pot and crack them all around. Do not remove the eggshell!
Place the eggs and the garlic in a jar, fill it with the spiced water and add the vinegar. Add water, if needed, so that the eggs are covered.
Let them rest for at least three days and at most two weeks at room temperature or slightly below.
